mainEntity.name: What is Rental Vehicle Damage Coverage?

acceptedAnswer.text:
Typically, when renting a car, you’re responsible for any damage caused to the vehicle, even if you’re not at fault. Over-the-counter insurance options for rental cars may only include liability insurance – which could leave you on the hook if there is damage to the vehicle. Travel Guard’s Rental Vehicle Damage Coverage provides coverage that can reimburse you for the cost of repair from damages caused by certain events which may include:

- Collison

- Vandalism

- Windstorm

- Hail

- Fire

- Flood

mainEntity.name: How do I use Rental Vehicle Damage Coverage during my trip?

acceptedAnswer.text: You’ll want to notify the rental car company as soon as the damage occurs to prevent further issues with the vehicle. If you were in an accident, contact the proper authorities and gather the information of the other driver – you’ll need this when you file a claim. When you get back home, you can file a claim for reimbursement and provide the proper documentation for your claim.

mainEntity.name: What documentation do I need to file a claim for Rental Vehicle Damage Coverage?

acceptedAnswer.text:
The specific documentation needed to file may vary depending on the circumstances around the damage and how much damage was done to the vehicle.

Below is a list of documentation that may be required:

- Copy of your rental contract

- Copy of police, accident or incident report

- Copy of repair estimate or invoice

- Pictures of the vehicle damage

- Proof of any payments made for the damage

Additional documentation may be required depending on your claim. You can start a claim online with our claims portal, or you can call us directly if you have specific questions.

mainEntity.name: Should I add Rental Vehicle Damage Coverage to my plan even if my credit card provides me with a plan?

acceptedAnswer.text: There’s often still value in adding Travel Guard’s Rental Vehicle Damage Coverage to your travel insurance plan. Many credit card companies offer some liability and collision coverage, but damage from events like hail or windstorms may not fall under those coverages. It’s important to review what coverage you may have through your credit card. Protect your travel investment and reduce the risk of unexpected expenses by making sure you have the coverage you may need when you’re responsible for a rental car.

mainEntity.name: Is Rental Vehicle Damage Coverage worth it?

acceptedAnswer.text: Yes! A travel insurance plan with Rental Vehicle Damage Coverage can help ease the financial burden of unplanned expenses from covered repairs and fees from the rental car company.

mainEntity.name: Is Rental Vehicle Damage Coverage affordable?

acceptedAnswer.text: It can depend on a few factors since a travel insurance plan is usually calculated based on several factors such as trip cost and the product you select. However, the Rental Vehicle Damage Coverage benefit through Travel Guard is around $12 per day on average.

mainEntity.name: Is Rental Vehicle Damage Coverage available for international trips?

acceptedAnswer.text: Yes, if your destination is covered by Travel Guard, and you have a valid license to drive in the country you’re renting a vehicle in, you can get coverage outside of the U.S.!
